achievements.name: Clan Level
achievements.detail: Raise any clan by one level.

achievements.name: Standard Win
achievements.detail: Win a standard run and bring the pyre through the last battle.

achievements.name: Heavy Hit
achievements.detail: Have a monster deal 100 or more damage in a single attack.

achievements.name: Heavy Spell
achievements.detail: Have a spell deal 175 or more damage in a single cast.

achievements.name: Luna Coven
achievements.detail: Unlock the Luna Coven so that clan can be chosen for a run.

achievements.name: Pyre Heart
achievements.detail: Unlock a second Pyre Heart to equip on later runs.

achievements.name: Full Rooms
achievements.detail: Play a room card on every floor during one battle.

achievements.name: Fully Equipped
achievements.detail: Attach equipment to six units in a single battle.

achievements.name: Stewards Gone
achievements.detail: Purge every Steward card out of the deck.

achievements.name: Covenant Four
achievements.detail: Win a run while Covenant 4 is active.

achievements.name: Seraph Down
achievements.detail: Defeat Seraph Aeternus in the last battle of a run.

achievements.name: All Covenants
achievements.detail: Win a run with every Covenant challenge enabled.
